# Amazon S3 Tables

Persist customer table buckets, one-level namespaces, table identities, rename versions and tags without Iceberg files or a query runtime.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `s3tables` |
| Signing name | `s3tables` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-05-10` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Metadata records only |
| Selected operations | 16 of 49 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-s3-tables) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Customer metadata only; no AWS-managed buckets/tables, namespace ARNs, warehouse/metadata/data files, Iceberg REST catalog, queries, object I/O, maintenance, replication, integrations, encryption/IAM execution or readiness.
- CreateTable metadata/schema, encryption and storage-class options are excluded; GetTable omits warehouseLocation, metadataLocation and managed-service results.
- CF requires explicit WithoutMetadata: Yes, excludes WarehouseLocation GetAtt and advanced schema/maintenance/encryption/metrics/replication properties; public version tokens remain fresh after effective rename compensation.
- The exhaustive [records guide](../guides/s3tables-records.md) lists all selected members, names, parents, tags, pages, tokens, CF boundaries and the executable CLI lifecycle; [runtime scope](../roadmap/services/s3tables-runtime.md) retains GetTableMetadataLocation and UpdateTableMetadataLocation as future work.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateNamespace` | `PUT /namespaces/{tableBucketARN}` |
| `CreateTable` | `PUT /tables/{tableBucketARN}/{namespace}` |
| `CreateTableBucket` | `PUT /buckets` |
| `DeleteNamespace` | `DELETE /namespaces/{tableBucketARN}/{namespace}` |
| `DeleteTable` | `DELETE /tables/{tableBucketARN}/{namespace}/{name}` |
| `DeleteTableBucket` | `DELETE /buckets/{tableBucketARN}` |
| `GetNamespace` | `GET /namespaces/{tableBucketARN}/{namespace}` |
| `GetTable` | `GET /get-table` |
| `GetTableBucket` | `GET /buckets/{tableBucketARN}` |
| `ListNamespaces` | `GET /namespaces/{tableBucketARN}` |
| `ListTableBuckets` | `GET /buckets` |
| `ListTables` | `GET /tables/{tableBucketARN}` |
| `ListTagsForResource` | `GET /tag/{resourceArn}` |
| `RenameTable` | `PUT /tables/{tableBucketARN}/{namespace}/{name}/rename` |
| `TagResource` | `POST /tag/{resourceArn}` |
| `UntagResource` | `DELETE /tag/{resourceArn}` |
